With an ornate look and gorgeous antique silver finish, this bookend holds three bottles of your favorite wine.About Old Dutch InternationalFamous for their copperware, Old Dutch International, Ltd. has been supplying the best in imported housewares and giftware to fine retailers throughout America since 1950. They offer a large assortment of housewares, including bakers racks, trivets, and pot racks in materials like chrome, colorful enamel, and stainless steel. Other product lines include wine racks, serving trays, specialty cookware, clocks, and other home accessories. Old Dutch warehouses and distributes their products from a 30,000 square foot facility in Saddle Brook, N.J.
